note: batt_kw 正＝充電；soc_pct 為該格結束時的電量，start_soc_pct 為第 1 格開始前；每份只含採用的 24 小時；devices 為可轉移設備每格開(1)關(0)；recommended 為三台都照建議時的開機格子與電費；prefs_stamp 為這份是用哪一版使用者設定算的

schedules.note: Day-ahead schedule from the group's MILP (realmilp_3.py, version 3): battery power and the start time of each shiftable device are optimised together. Load input = day-ahead non-shiftable forecast; a device runs only if the user scheduled it for this day (hems.user_prefs), once, without interruption, within the recommended range or the range the user set, or at the time the user fixed. Device times here are the day-ahead estimate: the real-time layer re-decides the start of devices not yet running every 15 minutes with the latest forecast. recommended = start slots (0-95) and cost if all three devices follow the recommendation (recommended range, same MILP). Battery lower limit 15% for all loads.
